name: Sum and product
description: You are given integers N and D . Find N positive integers x 1 ... x N such that the difference of their product and their sum equals D .
input_specification: The only line of input contains integers N ( 2 ≤ N ≤ 1000 ) and D ( 0 ≤ D ≤ 1000 ).
output_specification: Output N integers that satisfy the given condition in non-decreasing order (in a single line, separated with spaces). Note that some numbers can be equal. Numbers printed by you must not exceed 10 6 .
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
